def fetch_live_ap_snapshot(base_url: str) -> Tuple[bool, List[str], Dict[str, Any]]:
    """从运行态 ui-gateway 实时拉取 HTTP/SSE 状态并组装对账快照（绝不回退默认快照）。"""
    clean_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
    st_snap, snap_json = http_request_json(f"{clean_url}/api/v1/temperature/snapshot")
    st_job, job_json = http_request_json(f"{clean_url}/api/v1/jobs/status")
    st_mesh, mesh_json = http_request_json(f"{clean_url}/api/v1/leveling/mesh")
    st_sse, sse_evt, sse_json = read_first_sse_event(f"{clean_url}/api/v1/temperature/stream")
    sys_status = snap_json.get("system_status", "OFFLINE")
    mesh_ok = (st_mesh in (200, 503)) if sys_status == "OFFLINE" else (st_mesh == 200)
    if (st_snap, st_job, st_sse) != (200, 200, 200) or not mesh_ok or sse_evt != "temp_update":
        return False, [f"Live HTTP/SSE status error: snap={st_snap}, job={st_job}, mesh={st_mesh}, sse={st_sse}/{sse_evt}"], {}
    sse_match = (
        sse_json.get("system_status") == snap_json.get("system_status")
        and sse_json.get("bed", {}).get("temperature_millic") == snap_json.get("bed", {}).get("temperature_millic")
        and sse_json.get("tool", {}).get("temperature_millic") == snap_json.get("tool", {}).get("temperature_millic")
    )
    if not sse_match:
        return False, ["SSE temp_update payload does not match HTTP /api/v1/temperature/snapshot"], {}
    notes = [
        f"`GET /api/v1/temperature/snapshot` -> HTTP {st_snap} (`system_status={sys_status}`)",
        f"`GET /api/v1/temperature/stream` -> HTTP {st_sse} (`event={sse_evt}`, `system_status={sse_json.get('system_status')}`)",
        f"`GET /api/v1/jobs/status` -> HTTP {st_job} (`job_state={job_json.get('job_state')}`, `is_homed={job_json.get('is_homed')}`)",
        f"`GET /api/v1/leveling/mesh` -> HTTP {st_mesh} (`status={mesh_json.get('status')}`)",
    ]
    if sys_status == "OFFLINE":
        st_start, _ = http_request_json(f"{clean_url}/api/v1/jobs/start", "POST", b'{"model":"3DBenchy.gcode"}')
        st_home, _ = http_request_json(f"{clean_url}/api/v1/motion/home", "POST", b'{"axes":"ALL"}')
        notes.append(f"`POST /api/v1/jobs/start` -> HTTP {st_start}, `POST /api/v1/motion/home` -> HTTP {st_home}")
        snap_json["control_lock_http_status"] = st_start if st_start == st_home else 0
        return True, notes, snap_json
    st_fil, fil_json = http_request_json(f"{clean_url}/api/v1/filament/slots", "POST", FILAMENT_SLOTS_REQ)
    notes.append(f"`POST /api/v1/filament/slots` -> HTTP {st_fil} (`status={fil_json.get('status')}`)")
    fil_ok = st_fil == 200 and fil_json.get("status") == "ok" and fil_json.get("code") == 0
    return True, notes, assemble_live_online_snapshot(snap_json, job_json, mesh_json, fil_ok)

def stop_pty_daemon(work_path: pathlib.Path) -> int:
    """停止后台 C 固件 PTY 守护进程并清理 PID 与控制套接字文件。"""
    pid_file = work_path / "pty_pid"
    if pid_file.exists():
        try:
            os.kill(int(pid_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()), signal.SIGTERM)
        except OSError:
            pass
        pid_file.unlink()
    sock_path = work_path / "pty_ctl.sock"
    if sock_path.exists():
        sock_path.unlink()
    return 0
